subtopic: add, subtract, multiply, and divide signed integers
microSkill: apply directional number-line moves and same-sign/different-sign rules to evaluate signed-integer arithmetic
objectiveWording: Calculate with positive and negative integers and simple rational numbers using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, applying the correct sign rules.
successCriteria: Adds and subtracts signed integers correctly, treating 'subtract a negative' as a move to the right (e.g. -8 + 11 - 5 = -2; 3 - (-4) = 7).
Multiplies and divides signed integers using the sign rule (same signs give positive, different signs give negative), e.g. (-6) x (-4) = 24, (-20) / 4 = -5.
Distinguishes -3^2 = -9 from (-3)^2 = 9, using brackets to control the sign of a base under a power.
